Family.title: Brave
Family.description: A fearless young princess challenges tradition and embarks on an unforgettable journey where courage, family, and unexpected magic shape her destiny in remarkable and inspiring ways.

Family.title: The Good Dinosaur
Family.description: A young dinosaur forms an unlikely friendship with a brave human boy, discovering courage, loyalty, and the strength to overcome fear through an unforgettable adventure together.

Family.title: Elemental
Family.description: In a city where fire, water, earth, and air live together, two unlikely friends discover that understanding, kindness, and acceptance can overcome every difference between them.

Family.title: Encanto
Family.description: A magical family blessed with extraordinary gifts faces unexpected challenges as one determined girl discovers that love, hope, and unity are their greatest strengths of all.

Family.title: The Princess and the Frog
Family.description: A hardworking young woman finds herself on a magical adventure where dreams, friendship, and true love lead to unforgettable discoveries across a colorful and enchanting world.

Family.title: Frozen
Family.description: Two royal sisters embark on a breathtaking journey where love, courage, and hope help them overcome powerful magic while discovering the unbreakable bond that connects them forever.

Family.title: Frozen II
Family.description: Elsa and Anna travel beyond their kingdom to uncover ancient mysteries, facing magical challenges and emotional discoveries that forever change their future and strengthen their bond.

Family.title: Inside Out
Family.description: Inside a young girl's mind, her emotions work together through joyful and challenging moments, revealing how memories, feelings, and personal growth shape every important experience.

Family.title: Inside Out 2
Family.description: As Riley grows older, new emotions arrive with unexpected challenges, creating another heartfelt adventure about change, identity, friendship, and understanding every feeling within us.

Family.title: The Lion King
Family.description: A young lion prince begins an emotional journey of courage and self-discovery, learning the true meaning of responsibility, family, and embracing his rightful place in life.

Family.title: Soul
Family.description: A passionate musician unexpectedly explores the meaning of life through a remarkable adventure, discovering purpose, inspiration, and the small moments that make every day meaningful.

Family.title: Tangled
Family.description: A curious young princess leaves her hidden tower for an unforgettable adventure filled with friendship, discovery, courage, and the dream of finding her true place in life.

Family.title: The Incredibles
Family.description: A family of undercover superheroes reunites to face an incredible threat, proving that teamwork, courage, and trusting one another can overcome even the greatest challenges together.

Family.title: Up
Family.description: An elderly dreamer and an adventurous young scout set off on an extraordinary journey where friendship, hope, and unforgettable discoveries prove that adventure can begin at any age.

Family.title: WALL·E
Family.description: A lonely little robot discovers friendship and purpose while embarking on an unforgettable space adventure that reminds humanity of hope, love, and protecting the world they share.
